# GEPU International Football Academy

> GEPU International Football Academy is a youth football academy in the province of San Luis, Argentina. It welcomes young Saudi players aged 8 to 18 and runs an International Excellence Programme for selected Saudi players aged 14 to 17 (selection in Saudi Arabia, then a minimum 9-month immersion in Argentina). Its method combines the Argentine school (individual technique, creativity) with the Spanish school (tactical intelligence, collective play).

## Key facts
- Location: San Luis, Argentina
- Audience: young Saudi players, 8–18 years old
- Programme: 2 phases — Selection (14–17 years) and Immersion (minimum 9 months in residence in Argentina)
- Residence: modern accommodation for 30+ young international players
- Facilities: pitches, video rooms, performance centre
- Evaluation criteria: technique, speed, game intelligence, personality, character
- Philosophy: "Train before winning — the player first, then the result"
- Languages of the website: Arabic, French, English

## Founder
- Pelayo Morón Pendás — bilingual lawyer (English/Spanish) and talent scout with 20+ years in international youth recruitment; former head of recruitment for the Fulham FC academy in Spain and Portugal.
